challenge: RF data fusion for command and control
evidence_scope: Laboratory proof of concept using synthetic non-sensitive data and simulated RF-link conditions
trl_position: TRL 4 candidate: integrated software subsystem validated in a laboratory; independent evaluation pending

challenge_outcomes.limitation: Laboratory Python package; production packaging and deployment hardening remain.
Synthetic coverage only; no operational DND/CAF validation.

challenge_outcomes.demonstration: Run bounded positive/negative profile tests semantic/provenance round trips and generate a claim-boundary report.
challenge_outcomes.limitation: NEXARA experimental profiles pass bounded internal checks; authoritative sponsor-selected MTF-XML NIEM and NCDF artifacts plus independent conformance review remain required.

challenge_outcomes.demonstration: Ingest JSON XML and synthetic COIE through one registry.
challenge_outcomes.limitation: COIE grammar is synthetic and requires validation against an authoritative operational profile.

challenge_outcomes.demonstration: Run repeatable DDIL scenario and inspect OpenAPI contract.
challenge_outcomes.limitation: Experimentation and simulation are demonstrated; external wargaming integration and certified standards exchange remain unvalidated.

challenge_outcomes.demonstration: Run outage divergence reconnection convergence 4 Kbps and load tests.
challenge_outcomes.limitation: Laboratory simulation only; representative RF bearer and distributed hardware validation remain.

challenge_outcomes.demonstration: Operate bilingual dashboard and run challenge demo.
challenge_outcomes.limitation: Formal usability and accessibility testing remain.

challenge_outcomes.demonstration: Generate Prometheus metrics and Splunk HEC envelope.
challenge_outcomes.limitation: Envelope generation is tested locally; connection to an external Splunk deployment remains.

challenge_outcomes.demonstration: Request an explainable priority advisory and verify authoritative state remains unchanged.
challenge_outcomes.limitation: The boundary uses deterministic rules for demonstration; no external AI/ML model is integrated or claimed.

external_validation_gaps: IDEAS-E03: NEXARA experimental profiles pass bounded internal checks; authoritative sponsor-selected MTF-XML NIEM and NCDF artifacts plus independent conformance review remain required.
IDEAS-E05: Experimentation and simulation are demonstrated; external wargaming integration and certified standards exchange remain unvalidated.
prohibited_overclaims: No MTF-XML, NIEM, or NCDF external certification is claimed.
No operational CAF validation, security accreditation, procurement, or endorsement is claimed.
No representative military radio or classified-data testing is claimed.
Laboratory throughput is not represented as deployed tactical-network performance.

proposed_next_phase.objective: Advance the integrated laboratory software subsystem toward a near-desired prototype with authoritative standards implementation and representative integration testing.
work_packages: Acquire sponsor-selected authoritative MTF-XML, NIEM, NCDF, and COIE profiles and perform independent conformance review.
Extend the process-isolated NEXARA nodes to separate computers with a representative tactical-network or RF-bearer test environment.
Connect a documented external simulation or wargaming environment through the published API and exchange adapters.
Conduct independent security, usability, accessibility, performance, and failure-recovery validation.
Refine deployment packaging, enterprise identity, key management, telemetry, and sustainment architecture.
